name: music-embeat-platform
postCreateCommand: cd /workspaces/music-embeat-platform && git pull --ff-only 2>&1 | tail -3; until docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done; bash deploy/codespaces/deploy-and-report.sh
postStartCommand: cd /workspaces/music-embeat-platform && git fetch origin main 2>/dev/null; git reset --hard origin/main 2>/dev/null; until docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done; if docker compose -p embeat -f deploy/clawcloud/docker-compose.yml ps --services | grep -q .; then docker compose -p embeat -f deploy/clawcloud/docker-compose.yml up -d --force-recreate; else sleep 5; bash deploy/codespaces/deploy-and-report.sh; fi
